artworks.title: Comment on donne... le goût de la navigation
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. One is a child standing in a relaxed posture with short, curly hair and a solemn facial expression, wearing a simple garment. Beside the child is a jug, and in front of them is a wide, shallow bowl with a piece of bread. The second figure is an older man on all fours inspecting the bowl. The background includes a tall cabinet with items on top, against wooden paneling.

artworks.title: Un Père qui fait sucer à son fils...
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in a room. One figure is a man wearing a top hat, a dark coat over a light vest, and trousers, holding a glass. The other is a child, likely a boy, wearing an oversized coat or robe and striped pants, drinking from a large mug. In the background, there is a counter with various bottles and a pitcher, and a round object or painting on the wall. On the counter, an older man appears to be asleep, resting his head on crossed arms.

artworks.title: Une Famille chez qui réside l'instinct guerrier
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a room. One person on the left is holding a sword and wearing a large helmet, while the person on the right is holding a spear. The room is sparsely furnished with shelves and a cupboard filled with items.

artworks.title: Allons, papa... encore... trente-deux tours!...
artworks.description: The image displays three figures in full view. In the center is an adult man who appears to be skipping rope, with a slightly hunched posture, bent knees, and bent arms. He has disheveled hair, a round beard, wears glasses, a coat, a white shirt, a light vest, and striped trousers. Two children stand on either side, each holding an end of the skipping rope. The left child is in profile, wearing a long-sleeved top and pants, with short hair. The right child, a girl in a dress with hair tied back, seems to be pulling the rope. The background shows an interior setting with a framed picture hanging on the wall above them, and a smooth floor with a shadowed area indicating the rope and their movement.

artworks.title: Un Enfant qui s'amuse de peu...
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals sitting at a small round table. One person, an older man, sits on the right holding a newspaper, while a child sits on the left also reading a newspaper. The man wears a dark jacket and trousers, has short hair, glasses, and holds the newspaper with both hands. The child has curly hair and wears a dark top with light pants. Both are focused on their reading. On the table are a cup, saucer, a possible glass, and small plates. In the background, another adult is seated at an adjacent table with a hat on the wall behind them. The setting appears to be indoors with detailed wall design, resembling a café or similar venue.

artworks.title: Une Nuit agitée
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a bedroom setting. One figure is kneeling in front of a fireplace, tending to a fire. The other figure is sitting on a bed, holding a small child. The figures are wearing long garments and caps. The child is smaller and lies in the lap of the second figure. Next to the bed is a woven basket. The scene is set in a room with draped curtains in the background. The style of the image indicates it is a sketch, using shading and lines to depict details.

artworks.title: La Première leçon de natation
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals: a man and a child. The man is seen in a side profile standing beside a bathtub, slightly bent forward. His facial features include a round face, glasses, prominent nose, and thinning hair. He is wearing a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, waistcoat, and trousers, and holding a thermometer or similar object pointing toward the bathtub. The child is immersed in the bathtub, with only the upper part of their body visible above the water, including arms, face, and hair. The room has a curtain on one side, a picture on the wall, and a chair partially visible. The image is monochromatic with shading and lines for depth.

artworks.title: Plaisirs de la paternité
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his body turned to the side, holding a piece of fabric or paper in the air with his right hand. Several children interact with him, one clinging to his neck and three others reaching or pulling. The man appears middle-aged with slightly disheveled hair and wears striped clothing. The scene is set indoors with a desk or table beside him, carrying bottles and a loaf of bread. The background depicts a shaded area, possibly a wall or corner of a room.

artworks.title: Un Fils modèle
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one adult and one child, both in full-body view. The adult is standing on a cobbled street, holding a hat and the child's hand. They have dark hair and rugged facial features, wearing a long coat over a shirt and trousers. The child is pulling the adult ahead, with disheveled hair and dressed in a similar coat and pants. The background features old building facades on the left and shadows of more structures against a shaded sky on the right.

artworks.title: Ornamentation for a Dagger and Scabbard
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This drawing depicts ornate architectural elements. The intricate details include sections resembling columns or decorative capitals, with one capital featuring a human face flanked by mermaids and surrounded by ornamental leaves and scrolls. The style is meticulous, with rich textures and shading emphasizing depth and detail. Classic motifs such as acanthus leaves, volutes, and cherubs are present, reflecting opulent design sensibilities of the period. Additionally, an ornamental figure with a globe-like object and elaborate base contributes to the ornate composition.

artworks.title: Ah! monsieur... faut pas lui rire comme ça...
artworks.description: The image depicts three people standing in a room. A man in formal attire, including a suit, waistcoat, striped trousers, and a top hat, gestures with one hand while the other rests on his chest. A woman in a long dress and apron holds up a baby. The baby is dressed in a gown and looks toward the woman. In the background, there is furniture with a jug and a plate on a cabinet. The room is modestly decorated with curtains. The artwork is monochromatic and signed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le Jour de sortie
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a child. The man is bent over facing the child and has a serious expression. He wears a dark hat, coat, and light-colored pants with stripes. The child stands facing the man, wearing a hat, a light-colored smock, and holding an overfilled bag with visible objects protruding from it. They also hold a large ball or basket. A wall with a barred window is seen on the left, and a door with a sign reading "INSTITUTION" is partially visible behind the man. The ground is textured with cobblestones.

artworks.title: Inconvénient de mettre son logement...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals positioned in a room. The first person, clothed in a long, dark coat and top hat, is leaning forward to look out of a window. Their face is hidden. Behind them, the second individual stands with hands on hips. This person wears a long-sleeved garment and has an older appearance with defined cheekbones, a stern expression, and short wavy hair. The third individual is seated, immersed in a wooden tub, wearing a pointed nightcap and nightshirt. Their eyes are closed, and they have a tired expression. A dark curtain partially surrounds the scene, and snow can be seen falling outside through the window.

artworks.title: Mais monsieur le propriétaire, voyez...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing indoors near a fireplace mantel. The man on the left is leaning slightly backward with his hands possibly in his pockets. He has short wavy hair and is wearing a dark jacket over a white shirt and light-colored pants. The man on the right is facing the left, with one arm outstretched and gesturing. He has a full beard and curly hair, wearing a patterned long coat over pants. In the background, there is a fireplace mantel with decorations and a clock on top. The room has a stone or cobblestone floor, and shadows are cast by the men.

artworks.title: Déménagé!...
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with arms crossed, gazing downwards. He is facing slightly to the left. He is wearing a large top hat, a dark overcoat, striped trousers, and pointed shoes. A few items are scattered on the floor in front of him, including paper and a rolling pin. The background features patterned walls, with a partly visible staircase to the left.

artworks.title: Vue d'une antichambre ministérielle...
artworks.description: The image shows two men engaged in conversation. The man on the left is slightly bent forward, holding a hat in both hands, with a balding head and sharp facial features. He is wearing a suit with vertically striped pants. The man on the right stands upright with his hands in his pockets. He has a full head of hair and a more weary facial expression, wearing a waistcoat and a necktie. Several other figures are visible in the blurred background of a crowded indoor setting. The scene is in shades of gray, with a textured wall implying an interior environment.

artworks.title: Oui, monsieur Gimblet, l'ordre ne sera... rétabli...
artworks.description: The image shows two men conversing. Both men have distinct clothing styles and features. The man on the left has a hunched posture, angular face, prominent cheekbones, and short, unkempt hair. He wears a dark coat, vest, trousers, and high-collared shirt. The man on the right has a more rounded face, wears a brimless cap, a long, striped tunic, and light-colored pants. The setting appears to be outdoors, with a sketched backdrop of a hedge, trees, and a sky.

artworks.title: Madame, j'ai bien l'honneur!
artworks.description: There are three individuals in an art studio. The first person on the left is a man holding a palette and a brush. Next to him is an older man leaning on a walking stick. The third person is a young woman standing on wooden blocks. They are in front of a large blank canvas, with a background showing shelves and objects in the studio.

artworks.title: Comment, Saint-Gervais a pris cette...
artworks.description: In this image, two figures are in an art studio examining a sculpted arm. The setting shows an interior space with two figures inspecting a sculpted arm attached to a string. One figure is standing and the other is reclining on a table, holding up the arm. The room is decorated with framed artwork, including paintings and sketches of figures, and a sculpted head is mounted on the wall. There are artistic materials and tools visible in the space, indicating a focus on artistic processes such as sculpting and drawing. The scene conveys a moment of collaboration and careful study in an artist's studio.

artworks.title: Aperçois-tu un lieu civilisé...
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an outdoor rocky setting. One figure stands on the left with a forward posture holding a long stick, while the other figure kneels on the right also holding a stick. The first figure is shown from the back with one foot on a rock and the other lifted on a higher ledge. The second figure appears older, with distinct facial features and spectacles, wearing a long coat, head covering, and carrying a backpack. The background features lightly sketched landscape lines suggesting distant hills or mountains.

artworks.title: Inconvénient d'envoyer un mauvais tableau...
artworks.description: The image shows two men, one seated and the other standing. The seated man has curly hair, a thoughtful expression, and is wearing a dark jacket, light shirt, and striped pants. The standing man has wavy hair, a beard, and is dressed in a dark coat and layered clothing. The room they are in has framed paintings on the walls, a chest of drawers on the left, frames against the wall on the right, and a decorative piece on top of the furniture.

artworks.title: Tu m'reprendras encore... a aller souhaiter...
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals shown from the knees up. The male figure on the right is slightly bent forward and has prominent facial features, wearing a top hat, a dark cape or cloak over a suit, a tie, and boots. His hand is gesturing outward. The female figure on the left is also bent forward, wrapped in a shawl or cloak that covers most of her head and body, with a patterned skirt at her ankles. The background consists of a street scene with tall buildings against a dark, cloudy sky. The ground below the figures appears textured.

artworks.title: Est-il bon, au moins, votre vin!...
artworks.description: The image shows two seated men and one standing man outdoors. The man on the left is seen from the side, wearing a dark jacket, waistcoat, and light-colored trousers. He has short, light hair. Next to him, the second man sits facing slightly forward, wearing a top hat and similar clothing with a checkered pattern on his trousers. He holds a glass on the small table. The man standing on the right is shown in profile, with dark hair, wearing a vest over a shirt, rolled-up sleeves, and an apron. The background includes a row of tall trees. The setting is in a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: Une Gloire éteint l'autre
artworks.description: This image shows one figure putting a large conical hat on another figure. The drawing is of a caricature depicting exaggerated facial features. One individual holds the hat over another figure, who is crouched in a submissive posture. In the background, there is a group of faces depicted in a repetitive manner. The style uses strong contrasts, fine lines, and shading to emphasize the exaggerated forms and expressions, potentially conveying a satirical or humorous message.
